name: Solana DevNet Token Dashboard
description: Solana devnet users need a simple, free tool to create Token-2022 tokens, monitor their metadata on-chain, and track basic metrics (supply, holder count, transaction volume). This fills a gap between raw CLI tools and production dashboards. Revenue via optional premium analytics tier ($5–15/month per user) and affiliate commissions from token creators who graduate to Pump.fun or mainnet launches.
